svg.title: Graph of an indefinite quadratic form
svg.desc: The surface z equals x sub 1 squared plus 4 x sub 1 times x sub 2 minus 2 x sub 2 squared is a saddle through the origin. The horizontal axes are x sub 1 and x sub 2. The surface curves upward along (2,1) and downward along (1,-2), the two orthogonal principal-axis directions.
